description:
Use when someone names a watch rather than giving a reference number, such as Rolex Submariner, Daytona, Batman or Moonwatch, and wants to know the references.
name: the brand, model or nickname in plain words.
Returns JSON: Moda's reference pages that match, each with brand, model, reference, nickname, production years, a one-line summary and the page link. Moda publishes no prices.
name: find_watch_by_name
title: Find a watch by name
